description: Compare what it costs to verify (clean, validate) a list of email addresses with MillionVerifier, Reoon, DeBounce and Emailable, from their published credit packs and monthly plans. Use this when the user asks how much it costs to verify a number of emails, which email verification service is cheapest for their list size, or how many credit packs to buy. Give only the number of emails, never the addresses. Credits the user already holds with a supplier can be counted. Returns the packs ranked within comparable groups (one-time packs vs monthly plans, per currency), the price for this request, the cost allocated to this job, what is unconfirmed, the date each price was checked and the seller’s page. These are published list prices, not live checkout quotes; it does not verify emails or buy anything.

emails.description: How many email addresses need verifying (1 to 10,000,000). Only the count, never the addresses.

existing_credits.description: Unexpired verification credits the user already holds, by supplier (optional), e.g. {"reoon": 5000}.

goal.description: How to rank: lowest_cash_now = least money to pay now for whole packs or plans; lowest_job_cost = lowest cost allocated to this job (leftover credits keep their value); best_requirement_fit = best match to the stated use first.

lang.description: Language of the Formquote page linked in the answer (en, zh, ja, fr, de). The figures are the same; notes recorded by Formquote stay in their original language (mostly Chinese).

name: compare_email_verification_prices
title: Compare email verification prices
